about_short_description.short_description: Eduflow is a tool to build and run any kind of learning experience online.

product.name: Collaborative Learning Platform
product.description: A platform that facilitates interactive peer learning experiences, allowing learners to review each other's work anonymously and engage in practical learning activities.

product.name: Course Authoring Tool
product.description: An intuitive drag-and-drop tool for creating interactive courses quickly, supporting formatted text, images, videos, file uploads, and SCORM packages.

product.name: Analytics & Security
product.description: Tools to track training efficacy and learner progress, providing comprehensive analytics and ensuring robust data security.

product.name: API & Integrations
product.description: Extensive GraphQL API and integrations with LMS, Zapier, and SSO to connect Eduflow with other tools and access learner data.

product.name: Peer Feedback Platform
product.description: A system that enables structured peer feedback, allowing students to review each other's work anonymously and improve through guided rubrics and reflection.

product.name: Social Onboarding Platform
product.description: A platform designed to create engaging and effective onboarding experiences for new hires through guided exercises, collaborative activities, and progress tracking.
